关键词: Results of Operations and Financial Condition
主要内容: Waters Corporation, a U.S.-based company, filed a Form 8-K on January 22, 2013, to report its results of operations for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2012. The filing includes a press release dated January 22, 2013, which is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The report outlines the company's financial performance for the specified periods. The press release is incorporated by reference into the filing. The document is signed by William J. Curry, Vice President, Corporate Controller, and Principal Accounting Officer of Waters Corporation.
